title: Milken Institute publishes women’s health reimbursement roadmap
summary: On August 4, 2026, the Milken Institute published the Coverage and Reimbursement Roadmap for Women’s Health Innovation, a post-refresh material research output addressing coverage and reimbursement barriers for women’s health innovations.
